claims.text: Selective laser melting can introduce controlled porosity into HfMoTaTiZr.
Controlled porosity introduced by selective laser melting will decrease the density of HfMoTaTiZr relative to as-cast HfMoTaTiZr.
Selectively laser-melted porous HfMoTaTiZr will retain or slightly improve its room-temperature mechanical properties relative to the as-cast alloy.
Selectively laser-melted porous HfMoTaTiZr will retain or slightly improve its elevated-temperature mechanical properties relative to the as-cast alloy.
The proposed retention of mechanical properties extends to approximately 1000 °C.
A retained complex microstructure will prevent significant loss of mechanical strength despite the introduced porosity.
High-entropy-alloy effects will help prevent significant loss of mechanical strength despite the introduced porosity.
The proposed operating boundary is from room temperature to 1000 °C.
The proposed loading boundary comprises loading conditions relevant to high-temperature applications.
